decisions.reason: As a low-pile decorative carpet close to the existing interior portfolio, it fits knowledge the firm already has in materials, design and project sales, so with no negative signal and a growing market it is worth retaining and refining.

The hand-knotted wool silk carpet is adjacent to the firm's established offer and draws on its design, material and premium-positioning capabilities, which makes continued commercialization plausible under strong absorptive capacity.

Because this low-pile decorative carpet is closely related to products the firm already understands, management can learn from early market response and improve it at relatively low risk rather than withdraw it quickly.
A corner bench builds directly on the firm's core furniture competence and customization skills, so it is highly compatible with existing knowledge and should stay in the range.

This low-pile carpet remains near the firm's established accessories and interior-solutions business, and absent evidence of weak demand the firm would typically keep such a related extension in a growing industry.
The swivel shell chair is firmly within the firm's main expertise in seating, materials and workspace design, giving it strong scope to interpret feedback and improve the product commercially.
